title: Sentier mappings randonneur package profile
description: Profile of a randonneur datapackage as stored in data/<NN>-<source>__<target>/{technosphere,biosphere}.json. A self-describing mapping package.

source.description: Open source identifier dict (e.g. {name, unit} or {flow, unit}).

target.description: Target identifier dict. For ecoinvent (target_proprietary bridges) MUST contain only {database, code} — no name/reference product/location. Otherwise full open identifiers.

conversion_factor.description: Optional multiplier applied when units differ.
